description: Validation rules and business logic checks. Used by Validation Agent before executing ERP operations.

schema_validations.description: Field-level validations based on doctype schema

rules.description: All mandatory fields must be present
rules.check: For each mandatory field in doctype, verify value is not null/empty

rules.description: Field value must match field type

checks.Date: Value must be valid date in yyyy-mm-dd format
checks.Link: Value must exist in linked doctype
checks.Select: Value must be one of allowed options

rules.description: Link field value must exist in target doctype
rules.check: Query target doctype to verify record exists
rules.example: If customer='ABC Industries', verify Customer 'ABC Industries' exists

rules.description: Child table must have minimum required rows
rules.check: items table must have at least 1 row for Sales Order
rules.error_message: At least one item is required

sales_order.description: Customer credit limit must not be exceeded
sales_order.check_when: On submit of Sales Order or Sales Invoice
sales_order.error_message: Credit limit exceeded for {customer}. Outstanding: ₹{outstanding}, Credit Limit: ₹{credit_limit}
user_suggested_actions: Request credit limit increase from Credit Controller

sales_order.description: Delivery date must be after transaction date
sales_order.error_message: Delivery date cannot be before order date

sales_order.description: Item rate should not deviate significantly from standard rate (if setting enabled)
sales_order.logic: For each item, check rate matches rate in previous doc (QTN → SO → DN → SI)
sales_order.bypass_role: Role to Override Stop Action (from Selling Settings)

sales_invoice.description: Invoice amount should not cause excessive outstanding
sales_invoice.logic: If customer has payment_terms, validate against terms

sales_invoice.description: Stock should not go negative (if update_stock=1)

payment_entry.description: Payment amount must not exceed outstanding amount
Paid amount and received amount must match (for same currency)
payment_entry.error_message: Paid and received amounts don't match

stock_entry.description: Source and target warehouses must be different (for Material Transfer)
stock_entry.error_message: Source and target warehouses cannot be same

stock_entry.description: Stock must be available in source warehouse
stock_entry.logic: For each item, stock in from_warehouse >= qty

item.logic: No other item with same item_code exists

item.description: Stock UOM mandatory for stock items
item.logic: If is_stock_item=1, stock_uom must be set
item.error_message: Stock UOM is mandatory for stock items

referential_integrity_checks.description: Ensure linked records exist before creating relationships

checks.suggested_action: Create customer first or search for correct name

permission_validations.description: Check if user has permission to perform action

permission_levels.create: User must have 'Create' permission on doctype

user_permissions.description: User Permissions restrict which records a user can access
user_permissions.example: User may only see customers in 'Delhi' territory if User Permission set
user_permissions.check: If User Permission exists for doctype, verify record matches permitted values

data_quality_validations.description: Warn about potential data quality issues

warnings.check: SELECT name FROM `tabSales Order` WHERE po_no = '{po_no}' AND customer = '{customer}'
warnings.message: PO number {po_no} already used for customer {customer} in {existing_so}

warnings.description: Item rate significantly different from last transaction
warnings.check: Compare rate with last 5 transactions for same item-customer
warnings.message: Item rate (₹{rate}) is {deviation}% different from recent average (₹{avg_rate})
Item {item} stock ({stock}) is below reorder level ({reorder_level})

validation_order.description: Order in which validations should be performed
sequence: 4. Business rule validation (credit limit, stock, etc.)

warnings.message: Item ITEM-00001 stock (50) is below reorder level (100)

bypass_mechanisms.description: How to bypass certain validations when needed

methods.description: User with specific role can bypass validation
methods.example: Credit Controller role bypasses credit limit check

methods.description: User confirms they want to proceed despite warning
methods.example: User sees 'Stock below reorder level' warning but chooses to proceed

gst_validations.check: If gst_applicable, item.gst_hsn_code must be set

gst_validations.description: Place of Supply required for GST calculation
gst_validations.logic: Determined from shipping address (if goods) or billing address (if services)

e_invoicing_validations.description: e-Invoicing mandatory for companies with turnover >₹5 crore
e_invoicing_validations.note: Applicable from specific dates, check current regulations

e_invoicing_validations.description: All fields required for IRN generation must be present

is_import_rules.description: Primary IS validate rules (branch 04) — replaces hardcoded fallbacks in validation_agent

link_rules.user_message: {link_target} '{value}' was not found on your live ERP site. Upload or fix source data, or create the record in ERPNext.

messages.missing_required_field: Required field '{field}' is missing or empty in your uploaded data.
messages.empty_row_value: Row {row}: '{field}' must have a value before import.
messages.entity_leak: Row {row}: {doctype} record looks like the wrong party type (check column mapping).
